summary: Exact Software is dutch business software company, founded in 1984. About 1,600 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Exact is a Delft software company making cloud accounting, HR and ERP tools for small businesses, with staff from 50 nationalities and IND sponsor status.

culture.text: Its cloud software automates finance and HR for small businesses and accountants, with ERP for wholesale, manufacturing and construction.
Colleagues come from 50 different nationalities and work hybrid, from offices across the Netherlands and from home.
It puts weight on learning, with a personal 'My Development Journey' and training and coaching.
Its 2 open jobs here are mid-level roles in IT and finance in Delft.

open.text: Exact B.V. and Exact Cloud Development Benelux B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.
Both current postings need no Dutch and one mentions visa or relocation.
Some careers pages, such as the hiring FAQ, are only in Dutch.

growth.text: Staff numbers were 1,700 in 2013, 1,550 in 2015 and 1,600 in 2016.
It is owned by investment firm Kohlberg Kravis Roberts (KKR).

worth_knowing.text: Its accounting and ERP products now include AI agents.
